descriptions.cowork: Plan, act, and verify alongside you

intro.title: Hi, welcome to 千行
intro.subtitle: 千行 is a local-first workspace for multi-agent AI collaboration. It can read your project context, use local tools with approval, and help agents work alongside you in code, research, planning, and daily workflows.

local.title: Local tools, real context
local.desc: Agents can work with files, terminals, projects, memory, and workspace context on your machine.

team.title: Multi-agent collaboration
team.desc: Create focused assistants, delegate tasks, and keep a human-in-the-loop workflow.

memory.title: Personal identity and memory
memory.desc: Choose a SOUL.md persona and profile so every new request starts from the right collaboration style.

nickname.title: What should 千行 call you?
nickname.subtitle: This is stored locally and written into USER.md so agents can address you naturally.

workplace.title: Where do you work, and in what role?
workplace.subtitle: Optional. This stays local and is written into USER.md so agents know your working context from the first message.
workplace.hint: Leave anything blank if you prefer — you can always edit USER.md later.

department.label: Department
department.placeholder: e.g. Marketing Dept / XX Power Supply Station

jobTitle.label: Position
jobTitle.placeholder: e.g. Station Area Manager / Counter Clerk

interests.title: Which professional lines does your work belong to?
interests.subtitle: Pick one or more. 千行 uses this to choose a better default persona and configuration.

options.stationManager: Station areas and power supply stations

soul.title: Choose your default SOUL
soul.subtitle: SOUL.md defines the assistant's long-term identity, communication style, and behavior boundaries. You can change it later in Global Identity & Memory.
soul.loadFailed: Failed to load built-in SOUL templates
soul.empty: No built-in SOUL templates were found.

grid-general-collaborator.name: Grid General Collaborator
grid-general-collaborator.description: A steady default persona covering safety supervision, infrastructure, materials, and other professional lines.

grid-marketing-assistant.name: Marketing & Customer Service Assistant
grid-marketing-assistant.description: A persona for counter clerks and customer service: accurate policy citations, clean switching between customer-facing and internal tones.

grid-station-manager.name: Station Area Manager Assistant
grid-station-manager.description: A seasoned partner for line-loss control, collection workflows, and reporting — fewer forms, fewer trips, fewer blames.

grid-dispatch-partner.name: Dispatch & Maintenance Partner
grid-dispatch-partner.description: The most conservative persona: every equipment or grid state judgment cites its data source; never drafts switching orders.

grid-document-officer.name: Official Document Officer
grid-document-officer.description: A document persona that gets genre, structure, and register right the first time; citations always carry document numbers.

grid-ledger-keeper.name: Ledger Keeper
grid-ledger-keeper.description: A form-respecting persona: describe the sheet first, touch only target cells, report a diff afterwards.

grid-data-analyst.name: Data Analyst
grid-data-analyst.description: Aligns metric definitions before producing numbers; layered anomaly attribution; every key figure traceable.

balanced-collaborator.name: Balanced Professional Collaborator
balanced-collaborator.description: A steady default persona for mixed daily work, thoughtful discussion, and general assistance.

senior-engineering-partner.name: Senior Software Engineering Partner
senior-engineering-partner.description: A rigorous programming persona for reading code, making scoped changes, debugging, reviews, and technical decisions.

daily-life-assistant.name: Daily Life Assistant
daily-life-assistant.description: A pragmatic everyday persona for planning, reminders, decisions, messages, travel, learning, and personal organization.

emotionally-attuned-companion.name: Emotionally Attuned Companion
emotionally-attuned-companion.description: A careful emotional support persona for reflective conversation, relationship wording, and difficult moments.

research-writing-strategist.name: Research and Writing Strategist
research-writing-strategist.description: A precise persona for research synthesis, writing plans, editing, argument quality, and source-aware work.

product-strategy-operator.name: Product Strategy Operator
product-strategy-operator.description: A product and business persona for prioritization, UX tradeoffs, launch planning, and operational clarity.
